title: CDFlow: Building Invertible Layers with Circulant and Diagonal Matrices
abstract: arXiv:2510.25323v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Normalizing flows are deep generative models that enable efficient likelihood estimation and sampling through invertible transformations. A key challenge is to design linear layers that enhance expressiveness while maintaining efficient computation of the Jacobian determinant and inverse. We introduce a novel invertible linear layer based on the product of circulant and diagonal matrices. This decomposition reduces parameter complexity from $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ to $\mathcal{O}(mn)$ using $m$ diagonal matrices and $m-1$ circulant matrices while still approximating general linear transformations. By leveraging the Fast Fourier Transform, our approach reduces the time complexity of matrix inversion from $\mathcal{O}(n^3)$ to $\mathcal{O}(mn\log n)$ and that of computing the log-determinant from $\mathcal{O}(n^3)$ to $\mathcal{O}(mn)$, where $n$ is the input dimension. translated_title: CDFlow：基于循环矩阵与对角矩阵构建可逆层
translated_abstract: 标准化流是一类深度生成模型，通过可逆变换实现高效的似然估计和采样。一个关键挑战在于设计既能增强表达能力、又能高效计算雅可比行列式和逆矩阵的线性层。我们提出了一种基于循环矩阵与对角矩阵乘积的新型可逆线性层。这种分解方法使用 m 个对角矩阵和 m-1 个循环矩阵，在仍能逼近一般线性变换的同时，将参数复杂度从 O(n²) 降低到 O(mn)。通过利用快速傅里叶变换，我们的方法将矩阵求逆的时间复杂度从 O(n³) 降低到 O(mn log n)，将对数行列式计算的时间复杂度从 O(n³) 降低到 O(mn)，其中 n 为输入维度。我们基于该层构建了循环-对角流（CDFlow）。
tldr: 本文提出基于循环矩阵与对角矩阵乘积的新型可逆线性层CDFlow，利用快速傅里叶变换在保持表达能力的同时，将参数复杂度降至O(mn)，并将矩阵求逆和对数行列式计算的时间复杂度分别降至O(mn log n)和O(mn)。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CDFlow, a novel invertible linear layer based on the product of circulant and diagonal matrices, which leverages the Fast Fourier Transform to reduce parameter complexity to O(mn) and the time complexity of matrix inversion and log-determinant computation to O(mn log n) and O(mn) respectively, while still approximating general linear transformations.
